text: Checkout latency spiked when the Redis cache connection pool exhausted. The payment service also experienced cache timeouts.
Inventory requests failed after Redis cache connection pool exhaustion caused repeated timeouts.
Checkout and search saw elevated errors following certificate expiration in the shared gateway.
The inventory service was unavailable when the shared gateway certificate expired.
Billing outage traced to a credential rotation failure in the shared gateway.
Payment requests timed out during Redis connection pool saturation, also called cache exhaustion.
